endpoints.summary: List video generations, filterable by product_id and status
Create a video generation draft (reference or keyframe mode); returns plan_hash and a sourced estimate. A new paid attempt once approved
One video generation: status, stage, plan_hash, estimate, cost_cap, spend (spent/held/cap), pause, failure, segments with attempts, keyframes, frame_budget, media_asset_ids
Approve the current plan: plan_hash must equal the current plan_hash (409 otherwise), cost_cap in the estimate currency and at least the estimate. Freezes the snapshot and queues generation
Register a pause: already submitted segments continue, later submissions stop
Resume paused work, or a failure whose retry_action is resume; an optional cost_cap raises the cap
Reserve one keyframe slot (segment_index, position) against the authorized frame budget; authorized_budget raises the authorized total
Store a generated keyframe image for a reserved slot
Record the user's review of a keyframe version: approved, rejected or accepted_with_issues
Product detail: description, images, variants and the listing profile (bullet points)
Stored product video assets and the selected version
Mark a video version as selected, or record its quality verdict

response.description: Dark grey line sketch on an off-white background. Two L-shaped wall hooks on rectangular back plates and, to their left, a card sleeve with an outlined leaf mark; no lettering. The group is centred horizontally in the lower-middle of the frame with a clear margin on every side; every outline is complete.

Pure white background. Two wall hooks in light natural bamboo with visible grain, each a rounded L-shaped hook on a rectangular back plate with two screw holes, lying side by side at a slight angle. To their left a kraft-paper card sleeve printed in dark green with a small leaf mark, the lettering "Casa Verde" in a serif typeface and below it "2 uds". The products occupy about 80% of the frame and are fully in frame. No props, no other text.

args.prompt: Photoreal studio product photograph, vertical 9:16 (1080x1920), matching the exact composition of the line sketch in reference 2: two Casa Verde bamboo wall hooks in light natural bamboo with visible grain, each a rounded L-shaped hook on a rectangular back plate with two screw holes, lying side by side at a slight angle, and to their left the kraft-paper card sleeve printed in dark green with the small leaf mark, the lettering "Casa Verde" in a serif typeface and below it "2 uds", sharp and legible, exactly as in reference 1. The group sits centred horizontally in the lower-middle of the frame with a clear margin on every side, every edge fully in frame. Smooth off-white seamless background matching the sketch. Soft daylight from the top-left with a gentle white fill from the front, soft natural shadow. Still, crisp focus across the whole product, full-bleed image filling the whole frame.
